elements.name: Sessions empty and ready states
copy: The daemon is answering and two repositories are visible to it. A session is a worktree plus a thread, so starting one never touches your checkout.

missing.reason: no client draws the empty sessions state as designed: none of its lines exist. Desktop and web draw No session is open or No project is open whenever no session is active, even when sessions exist, and the drawer says No sessions on this machine yet.; the tablet draws nothing when there are no sessions; the phone draws its own Phone v2 idle state. Buildable now: the title, Start a session, and READY rows for providers and active projects with their branch. The repository rows with git state (clean, uncommitted count) and two repositories are visible to it need a repository listing RPC. Clone a repository is cut on every client (Q385 A, 2026-10-02), so it is not evidence

elements.name: Reading the thread
elements.where: loading state: rail skeleton rows, thread header skeleton with the reading line, bubble-shaped turns at 720px, composer skeleton, rail footer reading N machines, chrome pill connecting

partial.reason: split from states.sessions, which held its line. ThreadSkeleton draws full-width bars at first connect with reading <machine id or RPC URL>, so before attach it names a raw ws:// address; there are no rail skeleton rows, bubble shapes, composer skeleton, reading N machines footer or connecting pill. The shimmer and the reading line stay after the first attempt fails, under the Cannot reach the daemon banner: Q344 A (2026-10-02) stops the shimmer then and says Not connected. Nothing has been read from <host> yet. The phone draws its own Reaching the daemon state; the tablet falls back to the phone layout until a snapshot exists

elements.name: Failed session read state
copy: The daemon accepted the connection and then stopped answering mid-read. Domovoi will not show a partial thread, because a partial thread reads like a finished one.
nothing was written, nothing was lost

partial.reason: FailedReadState draws the frame, but its one caller is the provider-restart path in thread.tsx, not a failed session read. No caller passes attempts or Open the machine, so WHAT IT TRIED and the attempt count are never drawn. The line nothing was written, nothing was lost shows only where a caller says the failure only read, and no caller does: a provider can write files before it stops.

scriptBacklog.reason: Copy the design builds in its data script, collected by the gate since audit G23 and not yet read against the implementation. Classify each string as an element's copy, sample or annotations, and remove it here.
strings: The daemon answers and the list is empty. Empty is a state with a cause, so the screen names the cause.
Skeletons in the shape of what is coming, and a line saying which machine is being read.
A partial thread reads like a finished one, so Domovoi refuses to show one.
Two of three machines answered, so the count reads 2 of 3. No results and not searched are different answers.
The worktree is cut and no turn has been taken. The first message is what starts it.
Clear the search to see all three.
Sessions you start on this machine will appear here, newest first.
The session is still on the machine. A client that cannot read it has not changed it.
If a turn was running it is still running. The daemon does not need this window.
Any gate raised while you were away is still waiting, and will be here when the read succeeds.
Migrate billing webhooks to the new idempotency table
Read the repository. It cannot write until a gate or a rule permits it.
Write a plan you can read, edit and reject before any step runs.
Take a checkpoint before the first approved write, so every step is revertible.
Continue the search index backfill from its last checkpoint
Review the open pull requests by risk
Explain what changed in acme-api this week
